verses.text: Manhxo jantakok ix in tzalaj yet' heb' ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Konh t'a stemplo Jehová, xchi heb'.
Haxo tiknaik ay onhxo ek' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén tik.
Ha Jerusalén, junnhej chonhab'il yaj sb'o'i.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' tik sja junjun makanhil heb' schonhab' Jehová, yik wach' sb'itaj icha yutejnak yalankan t'a heb' ko mam kicham.
Ha t'a jun chonhab' tik ay juntzanh despacho b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima yuj yinhtilal winhaj David t'a stojolal.
k'anek to syak' junk'olal Dios t'a Jerusalén. Junk'olalokab' yaj heb' xajanan jun chonhab' tik.
Ayokab' junk'olal t'a yol smuroal yet' t'a yol spat sreyal jun chonhab' tik, xe chi.
Yuj swach'ilok heb' in k'ab' wok yet' heb' wetchonhab', yuj chi' swala': Ayokab' junk'olal, xin chi.
Yujto xajan skajnub' Jehová ko Diosal wu'uj, yuj chi' ol wak' wip in sayanek' tas tz'och swach'ilok Jerusalén tik.
